image_description: A close-up view of a silver-colored metal breastplate (cuirass) displayed on a black mannequin torso. The armor features intricate vertical embossed patterns, a central raised ridge, and a horizontal slit near the top. The surface is polished but shows signs of age or texture, reflecting light unevenly due to the embossing. A portion of a fauld (waist armor) is visible at the bottom.
